name: UniOne
description: Send transactional emails through the UniOne email API.
project_description:
The UniOne module provides an easy way to enable Drupal-based projects to send emails through the UniOne Email API . The module was developed using UniOne's SDK for PHP . Created for Drupal 10 and 11 versions with further updates.

 Back to top 

 UniOne’s capabilities 
 
 Sending speed up to 60 emails per hour 
 The high delivery rate of 99.88% 
 Effortless sign-up process 
 24/7 friendly support 
 Free 4-months trial 
 Attractive pricing 
 
 Back to top 

 UniOne Drupal module’s capabilities 
 
 Sending transactional, notification, trigger, or any other types of automated emails 
 Creating and using email templates 
 Adding attachments to your emails 
 Getting all the analytics of your sendings in the UniOne account 
 
 How to use 
 Here is a guide on how to get started with the module . Before setting up, please ensure that you already have an account at UniOne, or sign up for free.
